translation:
In the conditions of injury, pain in the muscles is caused by stagnation of the nutritive and defensive (榮衛) qi; one should use Restorative Qi-Penetrating Powder (復元通氣散). Pain among the sinews and bones is injury to the qi of the liver and kidney (肝腎); use Six-Ingredient Rehmannia Pill (六味地黃丸).
<ins>Six-Ingredient Rehmannia Pill (六味地黃丸)</ins>
Cooked rehmannia (熟地黃, eight liang), cornel (山萸肉, core removed, four liang), Huai yam (懷山藥, four liang), moutan bark (牡丹皮, three liang), alisma (澤瀉, three liang), poria (茯苓, three liang)
Grind all together into powder, make into pills with refined honey the size of tung tree seeds; on an empty stomach, take three qian with plain water.
<ins>Restorative Qi-Penetrating Powder (復元通氣散)</ins> (the formula is found under internal conditions of injury, 傷損內證)
